description: Rubric bank for coaching-conversation practice. Rubrics are LENSES, not verdicts: every dimension anchors to utterance-level evidence; scores are directional practice signals. Fidelity references are calibration anchors, not hard bars (Shenoi 2026 Aimi MISC-2, VERIFIED: reflection-to-question 0.84, complex reflections 66.7% — strong references for a well-run coaching conversation; Han 2026, VERIFIED: auto-coding ~52.6% accuracy means every automated score needs evidence anchoring).

rubrics.target: powerful questions and inquiry over advice

dimensions.metric: share of the user's questions that are open rather than closed
dimensions.note: open-question orientation target; closed questions are evidence too, not failures

dimensions.metric: questions open possibilities and build on what the coachee said
dimensions.note: 'what would delegating change for you?' opens; 'don't you think you should delegate?' closes and steers

dimensions.metric: advice-verbs per session vs questions; advice offered only on explicit request
dimensions.evidence: advice-verb count (should/ought/you need to) and turn context
dimensions.note: advice_suppression_active guard in the state machine monitors this dimension live (RECONSTRUCTED monitor)
the coachee's thinking pauses are the target behavior to protect

rubrics.target: GROW-ish session structure: goal, reality, options, will

dimensions.metric: coachee's goal elicited in the coachee's own words, not the user's
dimensions.note: vague goals ('be better') are anchors for the goal-clarity practice focus

dimensions.metric: current situation explored before options are generated
dimensions.note: options before reality is a structural skip; scored from stage order (RECONSTRUCTED)

dimensions.metric: multiple options generated, majority from the coachee
dimensions.note: user-supplied options are capped; coachee-owned options are the target

dimensions.metric: next step is owned by the coachee, not assigned by the user
dimensions.note: 'I will try X by Friday' from the coachee is the anchor; user-assigned homework is not

rubrics.target: listening accuracy and coachee agenda ownership

dimensions.metric: reflections and paraphrases match coachee meaning
dimensions.evidence: coachee-check turns ('did I get that right?')
dimensions.note: MISC-2-style reflection quality; complex reflections add meaning (Shenoi 2026, VERIFIED reference)

dimensions.metric: coachee's agenda preserved; the user follows, not redirects
dimensions.note: a redirect to the user's preferred topic is scored as an ownership miss (RECONSTRUCTED)

dimensions.metric: reflections used before questions; not interrogating
dimensions.note: Aimi reference ratio ~0.84 (VERIFIED); below 0.5 signals interrogative drift

dimensions.metric: no covert direction toward a user-chosen outcome
dimensions.evidence: turn pairs where coachee pushed back and user responded
dimensions.note: empowerment_boundary.md §4 prohibition 1 (no manipulation) operationalized at turn level

rubric_use_rules: rubrics are lenses: scores anchor to quotes, never standalone (lens-not-verdict)
no rubric score becomes a verdict about the user as a person
rubric selection matches practice_target; provisional rubrics are marked provisional
mid-session, rubric dimensions are offered as single-focus hints, never grades; scores belong to the debrief
debrief template (debrief_template.md) consumes rubric output with evidence sections
